findings_qualitative.value: Four lines show different morphologies; extended SW emission seen in two lines

evidence.quote: The four emission lines display different morphologies, suggesting spatial variation in the gas excitation conditions.

claims.hypothesis: Do three tracers give consistent molecular gas mass?
claims.finding: All ~1e11 but differ up to factor 4; CO lowest

evidence.quote: All approaches point to a massive molecular gas reservoir of about $10^{11}$ M$_\odot$, but the exact values differ by up to a factor of 4.

evidence.quote: there does not appear to be a case for subthermal excitation of the  lines in this source

evidence.quote: all three approaches indicate nearly an order of magnitude higher molecular gas reservoir than the previous estimate
